title: Reading Drill — Testing a lower stage for assemblies — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a lower stage for assemblies — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The hall technician in Millcross received an old report about speakers becoming harder to see from the back. The report compared the distance at which a speaker's face is clear, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the seat-by-seat checks rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include differences in audience height. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed staggered rows as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
